disclosures: The RC11 control runs after the candidate in the same saved gate run; a reload can separate their visits (see timestamps). Device temperature and clocks are not controlled or measured; the control may be warmer.
A five-second FPS pre-check is a readiness proxy, not a temperature measurement. Sequential deltas do not prove the cool-clock +1 ms target.
Per-pass windows contain the first/last 20 populated samples; short or intermittent passes can have overlapping windows. Counts and time ranges are reported.
Budget verdicts require the pinned RC11 identity, complete timed windows, affirmative non-calibration samples, GPU timestamps, and equal known fixed output dimensions.
A 30-second control often has fewer than 40 GPU samples; its drift is then unmeasured rather than using overlapping windows.
